basis: docs/WEAPON_TIER_3_BALANCE.md, 'Tier 3 analysis'. Damage, speed, timing, stamina, reach and block are on the tier curve for every Tier 3 weapon; the one numeric outlier is the Tier 3 spears' armor shred (WeaponConfig.PierceValueMin/Max): the Survival Spear has the Tier 4 Trident's 5-12 and the Yari the Tier 2 Pike's 4-9.
